Card Q&A.a: You can give that effect to such Digimon, but if the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the gained effect won't trigger.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to give "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks" to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to give "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks" to a Digimon, can I choose to not attack for the part of the effect after "then"?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks." Then, this Digimon may attack.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When attack targets change, trash your opponent's top security card.
